snippet.title: PLAY RINGFALL.
snippet.description:
Be the first to fight for a future worth missing.
SIGN UP HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359380/RINGFALL/
Join RINGFALL's Pre-Alpha "Foundations Test"!
September 17th → September 21st

We are going public with this Pre-Alpha test because we see the community as a core part of the development process and want to be open with our decisions, goals and direction.

This is your chance to not only play RINGFALL, but to also kick our asses at our own game. We'll be online receiving feedback, discussing our game's future, as well as being available to address any concerns that may arise during play.

During the event, we'll be hopping into your matches as well as jumping into the conversation on our Discord server.
